{"draft": "Microchip Technology Q1 FY2027 recap
Results:
- Revenue: $1.485 billion, up 38.0% from a year earlier and climbed 13.2% sequentially
- GAAP gross profit: 63.2%
- GAAP operating income: $336.8 million, or 22.7% of net sales
- GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders: $202.0 million, with EPS of $0.37 per diluted share
- Non-GAAP gross profit: 63.8%
- Non-GAAP operating income: $521.1 million, or 35.1% of net sales
- Non-GAAP net income: $438.6 million, with EPS of $0.76 per diluted share
Operations:
- Inventory days: 175 days, down from 185 days on March 31
- PCIe Gen6 connectivity design wins: 12 programs exiting the June quarter
Cash and capital:
- Returned to common stockholders through dividends: approximately $246.9 million
- Quarterly dividend declared for the September quarter: 45.5 cents per share
- Net debt reduction during the June quarter: approximately $170 million
Outlook:
- September quarter net sales: expected to rise 7% to 9% sequentially
- September quarter growth at the midpoint: approximately 40.6% from a year earlier
- Capital expenditures for all of fiscal 2027: expected to be approximately $100 million"}
